Capture the Analysis Environment for a Manifest

Source: R/lib_capsule.R
capenv.Rd

Records the facts a replicator needs to rebuild the session in which a result was produced: the R version, platform and operating system, a UTC timestamp, the random number generator in use and whether it was seeded, and the versions of the packages involved. Store the result in a results manifest (for example with wrmnfjs()) next to the numbers it produced, and compare two captures with envdiff().

Usage

capenv(pkgs = loadedNamespaces())

Arguments

pkgs

Character vector of package names to record. Defaults to every currently loaded namespace (loadedNamespaces()).

Value

A list of seven elements:

r_version

character, e.g. "4.5.1".

platform

character, R.version$platform.

os

character, the system name and release.

captured_utc

character, ISO 8601 time YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

rng_kind

character, the three RNGkind() values joined by commas.

rng_seeded

logical, whether .Random.seed exists.

packages

named list of version strings, sorted by name (NA for a package that is not installed). A list, not a vector, so the names survive the manifest's JSON: a named vector is written as a bare array.

The list has class c("rmbl_capenv", "list"), which only changes how it prints (a box); its elements, and the JSON written from it, are those of a plain list.

Details

Package versions come from utils::packageVersion(); a package that is not installed gets NA rather than an error. The packages are sorted and de-duplicated. The generator kinds come from RNGkind() (R has changed its default sample() algorithm before, so a recorded seed means nothing without the kind it was fed to), and rng_seeded says whether .Random.seed exists in the global environment. Nothing is written and the random state is not touched.

Examples

# Record specific packages' versions alongside the session facts.
env <- capenv(c("stats", "utils"))
env$r_version
#> [1] "4.6.2"
env$os
#> [1] "Linux 7.0.0-1017-azure"
env$packages          # named list of versions
#> $stats
#> [1] "4.6.2"
#> 
#> $utils
#> [1] "4.6.2"
#> 

# Default captures every currently loaded namespace.
names(capenv())
#> [1] "r_version"    "platform"     "os"           "captured_utc" "rng_kind"    
#> [6] "rng_seeded"   "packages"    

# the generator and whether it was seeded
set.seed(42)
capenv("stats")[c("rng_kind", "rng_seeded")]
#> $rng_kind
#> [1] "Mersenne-Twister,Inversion,Rejection"
#> 
#> $rng_seeded
#> [1] TRUE
#> 

# a package that is not installed is recorded as NA, not an error
capenv(c("stats", "notapackage123"))$packages
#> $notapackage123
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $stats
#> [1] "4.6.2"
#>
